mapper.select: SELECT repository_id, SUM(asset_count) AS assets, SUM(bytes) AS bytes, SUM(CASE WHEN component_id IS NOT NULL AND last_used < #{unusedSince} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unused_components, SUM(CASE WHEN component_id IS NOT NULL AND last_used < #{unusedSince} THEN bytes ELSE 0 END) AS unused_bytes, SUM(CASE WHEN component_id IS NOT NULL AND last_downloaded IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS never_downloaded_components, SUM(CASE WHEN component_id IS NOT NULL AND last_downloaded IS NULL THEN bytes ELSE 0 END) AS never_downloaded_bytes FROM (SELECT repository_id, component_id, COUNT(*) AS asset_count, COALESCE(SUM(asset_blob_size), 0) AS bytes, MAX(last_downloaded) AS last_downloaded, MAX(COALESCE(last_downloaded, created)) AS last_used FROM ${format}_asset GROUP BY repository_id, component_id) per_component GROUP BY repository_id;

SELECT c.component_id, c.repository_id, c.namespace, c.name, c.version, c.created, (SELECT MIN(b.created_by) FROM ${format}_asset a JOIN ${format}_asset_blob b ON b.asset_blob_id = a.asset_blob_id WHERE a.component_id = c.component_id) AS created_by, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(n.request_path) FROM ${format}_browse_node n WHERE n.component_id = c.component_id AND n.asset_id IS NULL), (SELECT MIN(n.request_path) FROM ${format}_browse_node n WHERE n.component_id = c.component_id)) AS browse_path FROM ${format}_component c WHERE c.component_id IN #{componentId};
